description:
T1-T3	2 x Plum & 1 x Sycamore	Front garden right hand side.
Cut back 2 x plums by1.5m and 1 x Sycamore in front of house back by 3m to fence line.	

H1	Leyland Cypress	Rear garden right hand side.
(Hedge) Reduce height of hedge to gutter level (2/2.5m) and trim customers side of hedge as hard as possible retaining green growth approximately 1.5m

A1	Mixed trees and shrubs	Rear garden middle of lawn, it separates the two gardens, Fell everything in this area as close to ground level as possible and remove all arisings due to items being in poor condition and poor aesthetics..

T4	Robinia	Rear garden with side access.
Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by up to 3 metres

T5	Sycamore	Cut back to fence line off of customers garden approximately 3m
